items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: And I took my horn out and you know, for the cats we blew with them, what not, hung out. Because I knew Nat King Cole from Chicago.

ctx.x: That's Earl's great solo, you know. So we wrote -- I wrote all of this stuff, and we were able to make enough money to get out of California. In the meantime we were invited out by Nat King Cole to go hang out with him at a party, he was playing a party for some big people there in Hollywood, and then we went out and was drinking and eating and having a night with Nat King Cole. And this is when he was playing the piano, and he had just first really started to try to sing, you know. Evidently he had done it…
Prince French was the bass player?
